## Description

Counsel reviews the clinic privacy notice, Medvya Terms, clinic DPA, patient consent texts (treatment, reminders per channel, sharing/ABHA/HIE, portal, marketing) for India (DPDP Act + Rules, commencement schedule) and the UAE (if in scope), plus the retention map from P0. Translated versions reviewed for en/hi/ar.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Approved texts with version numbers (e.g. v2026.2) are stored in the repo and loaded into consent templates.
- [ ] **AC2.** Review notes list any change to the consent model and the resulting ticket updates.
- [ ] **AC3.** Sign-off is recorded before the first real patient is registered (P1 for demographics).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
